source: systemctl list-units 'tradebot_*' --state=active on the trading host; risk caps read from each service's own launch arguments or config file

systems.name: BCO Brent Trend
systems.mechanism: Daily Donchian-10 breakout, chandelier trailing stop

systems.name: WTICO WTI Trend
systems.mechanism: Same family as Brent, separate parameters

systems.name: DE30 Channel v9
systems.mechanism: Intraday rolling-channel breakout, M1 source bars

systems.name: NAS100 Swing Chan
systems.mechanism: 576-bar rolling channel, gated by a peer volatility-regime filter

systems.name: NAS100 Vol Brk
systems.mechanism: Volatility-expansion breakout (2.2x realised-vol ratio), same regime gate

systems.name: MR SPX500 Dip
systems.mechanism: 20-bar z-score oversold mean reversion, 2.5x ATR stop, 7-bar hold

systems.name: MR UK100 Dip
systems.note: Live and evaluating signals, but capped at zero: it will not size a position.

systems.name: VRP
systems.mechanism: Variance-risk-premium sleeve across NAS100, FR40, UK100, NL25, AU200, JP225, HK33
systems.note: 1.75% is a pooled cap across all seven legs.

systems.name: Gold Trend TSMOM
systems.mechanism: Three-speed MA crossover (10/50, 20/100, 50/200), long-only, 8% annualised volatility target, trades only above 1,000 NAV
systems.note: Sized to a volatility target rather than a fixed per-trade risk cap.

changes.name: HK33 Camarilla Fade
changes.note: Disabled following a scheduled fleet review. Live and trading for the first three days of this record; its four losing trades (about -7 GBP) are included.

changes.name: DE30 M5
changes.note: Disabled following the same review. Live for the first three days of this record; its trades are included.
